name: paceva-garmin-mcp

tools.name: get_daily_overview
tools.description: One day from Garmin in one call: the daily summary (steps, resting heart rate, stress, calories, intensity minutes), the night's sleep, overnight HRV and Body Battery.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

include_series.description: Include minute-by-minute series. Off by default: long series come back as count, min, max and average.

tools.name: get_daily_summaries
tools.description: Daily totals for a range of days: steps, distance, calories, resting heart rate, stress, intensity minutes, floors. Up to 92 days per call.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Sleep for one night (stages, score, overnight heart rate, respiration) or, with an end_date, a nightly summary per day across a range. A night is filed under the date you woke up.

start_date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

include_series.description: Include minute-by-minute series. Off by default: long series come back as count, min, max and average.

tools.name: get_hrv
tools.description: Overnight HRV: for one night, the summary and readings; with an end_date, the nightly average, weekly average, baseline and status for each day in a range.

start_date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

include_series.description: Include minute-by-minute series. Off by default: long series come back as count, min, max and average.

tools.name: get_body_battery
tools.description: Garmin Body Battery per day: charged, drained, highest and lowest, for one day or a range.

start_date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

include_series.description: Include minute-by-minute series. Off by default: long series come back as count, min, max and average.

tools.name: get_stress
tools.description: Average and maximum all-day stress per day over a range.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_steps
tools.description: Steps, distance and step goal per day over a range.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_heart_rate
tools.description: One day's heart rate: resting, minimum, maximum, the 7-day resting average, and (with include_series) the readings through the day.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

include_series.description: Include minute-by-minute series. Off by default: long series come back as count, min, max and average.

tools.name: get_spo2
tools.description: Blood oxygen (SpO2) for one day, with altitude acclimation where the watch reports it.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

include_series.description: Include minute-by-minute series. Off by default: long series come back as count, min, max and average.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: Recorded activities, newest first: type, start time, duration, distance, heart rate, power, pace and training effect. Filter by date range or type (for example running, cycling, lap_swimming, strength_training). Use get_activity for one activity in full.

activity_type.description: Garmin activity type key, e.g. running, cycling.

offset.description: Skip this many, for paging. Default 0.

tools.name: get_training_log
tools.description: Every activity in a period, with the main fields from Garmin's activity list under Garmin's own names and values: distance (m), duration (s), speed (m/s), grade-adjusted speed, elevation, heart rate, cadence, power and power curve (maxAvgPower_<seconds>), TSS, intensity factor, training effect and load, fastest splits (fastestSplit_<metres>, in seconds) and seconds per heart rate and power zone. Up to 366 days per call.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

sport.description: Only activities of this sport, by Garmin activity type. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: One activity in full: summary, laps or splits where available, and with include_workouts the structured workout it followed.

include_workouts.description: Also fetch the structured workout, if any.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Profile settings from Garmin Connect (units, age, sex, height, weight and others) and heart rate zones.

tools.name: get_weight
tools.description: Weigh-ins over a range, with body fat, muscle mass and BMI where a scale records them.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_fitness_age
tools.description: Garmin's fitness age for a date.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_hydration
tools.description: Logged water intake against goal per day over a range.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_food_log
tools.description: Foods logged in Garmin Connect for one day, with calories and macros.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_menstrual_cycle
tools.description: Cycle tracking for a date, if it's tracked in Garmin Connect.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

instructions: Read-only access to the user's own Garmin Connect data through Garmin's Personal API. Responses are Garmin's data as Garmin returns it, in Garmin's field names and units (metres, seconds, metres per second), with empty fields and account IDs left out. Long minute-by-minute series are summarized as count, min, max and average unless include_series is set. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone.
